data.name: Caesura
data.detailed_description:
The World Sleeps

When you begin, the world is completely black and white and there is no music whatsoever. Everything except for you is frozen in time. As soon as you find your first musical instrument you can play it to bring a small pocket of the world back to life. Use your instrument to make platforms move, enemies move, and open up new traversal options.

Discover New Songs

Solve puzzles to make the music stronger. When you begin your music is quiet  and simple, as you solve more puzzles the world starts to play and dance along with the music and add more of its own layers to the songs. Completing areas allows you to hear all that the songs have to offer and unlock exclusive secrets that the music unlocks.

Uncover Secrets

Why is the world asleep and why did the music stop? Why are you the one to try to bring it back? Find exclusive items and secrets to uncover the true power of music to heal and uncover hidden meanings

Features

  • About 2 hours of playtime

  • 3 instruments to discover

  • 40+ platforming puzzle rooms

  • 6 audio tracks to build

  • No bananas to be found

data.short_description: Explore caves, forest, and clouds to discover new secrets in the mysterious world of Caesura. A rhythm driven, hand drawn world. Match your jumps and dashes to the beat to solve challenging puzzles that ask you to dance along with the world as it also dances to the beat.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 version 21H1 (build 19043) or newer
  • Processor: Intel Core i3-3240, AMD FX-4300
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: GeForce GTX 560 Ti (1GB), Radeon HD 7750 (1GB)
  • DirectX: Version 10
  • Storage: 1 GB available space
